CustomField.description: Field to unlink WSONE app from all the code execution, does the check in a formula (insted of code)
CustomField.formula: AND( OR( (RecordType.DeveloperName = 'B2C'), AND( (RecordType.DeveloperName <> 'B2C'), NOT( AND( OR( AND( (TEXT(BillingCountryCode) <> 'NL'), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(BillingCountryCode))) ) , AND( (TEXT(BillingCountryCode) = 'NL'), (WSONE_DATA__DutchBusinessValidationStatus__c = 'VALIDATED') ) ), NOT( ISBLANK(CoC_Number__c) ), OR( ISNUMBER(CoC_Number__c), (CoC_Number__c = '-') ), (CoC_Number_Confirmation_Required__c = CoC_Number_Confirmation__c), NOT( ISBLANK(VAT_Number__c) ), (VAT_Number_Confirmation_Required__c = VAT_Number_Confirmation__c) ) ) ) ) , AND(ISBLANK(BillingStreet), ISBLANK(BillingCity), ISBLANK(BillingPostalCode), ISBLANK(TEXT(BillingCountryCode))) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Block Syncing to exact is TRUE when this account is not validated and checked by WSONE, the supplied COC Number is valid and a VAT Number is supplied.
CustomField.label: Block Syncing Financial System
